## Before you send it

- [ ] It lives in `widgets/<name>/`, with an `addon.json`, its file or files, and a `screenshot.png`
- [ ] `python3 tools/catalogue.py check` says there is nothing to put right
- [ ] The picture is drawn from stand-in content: nobody's address, calendar or names are in it
- [ ] If it changes a widget already here, its `version` has gone up
- [ ] Anything it asks for under `permissions` is explained above
- [ ] I wrote it, or may share it, and offer it under this repository's licence (MIT)
